title: Titanium Concentric Reducer
system: Chemical Pipe Fittings & Flow Control Components
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Concentric Reducer where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Seamless concentric pipe reducer requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by seamless concentric pipe reducer and fat life requirements.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for pipe fitting geometry
CNC corrosion allowance with 0.5mm corner radius
TIG welding Grade 2 with 0.5mm corner radius
Hydrostatic shell test with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for seamless concentric pipe application
commonFailures: Pitting in stagnant HCl above 60C - requires Grade 12 for Mo-enhanced passive film stability — critical for seamless concentric pipe performance

faq.q: What acids is Titanium Concentric Reducer resistant to?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti shows excellent resistance to nitric acid (any concentration up to boiling), acetic acid, most organic acids, and dilute sulfuric acid (<10% up to 40°C). For seamless concentric pipe handling hydrochloric acid, Grade 12 (Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni) would be specified instead of Grade 5. Corrosion rates in nitric acid are <0.05 mm/year at all concentrations.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Concentric Reducer orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Concentric Reducer is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Concentric Reducer?
faq.a: Each Titanium Concentric Reducer shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for seamless concentric pipe.
